Unlayer

Select a recording to separate it directly in this browser. No Python installation or audio upload is required. First use downloads a ~172 MB pretrained model; caching depends on available browser storage.

Four estimated parts: vocals, drums, bass and other. Guitar and keyboard remain in Other. All waveforms share a timeline. Separation can take several minutes and needs substantial device memory; use desktop Chrome or Edge for best compatibility.

MP3, WAV, M4A, FLAC · 50 MB · Up to 10 minutes, subject to device memory. Cancel stops processing. Audio stays in page memory and is cleared on reload. Model/runtime files are downloaded from Hugging Face and jsDelivr; your audio is not sent to them.

The chart shows one-second RMS dBFS and Details shows sample peak. LUFS, true peak and LRA are unavailable in this browser version. These digital levels do not measure listening volume.

Browser separation uses demucs-web (MIT), Meta Demucs and ONNX Runtime Web.
